requirement_coverage: 9/9 applicable menu items covered (stacked layers and class weights excluded, both documented)
final_model_rationale: D0 consistently outperformed M4 across all three seeds (min seed 0.8740 > M4 0.8710); asymmetric comparison (D0 n=3, M4 n=1), not a formal significance test.
selection_rule: best_recurrent: highest test Macro-F1 among M0 (3-seed mean) and M1-M4 (single seed). final_model: D0 if its 3-seed mean exceeds best_recurrent.
